arm_2026_06_manual_delta.name: Arm A-profile Instruction Set Architecture manual

queue.action: Acquire and pin an Arm-authorized 2026-06 machine-readable A-profile instruction package or a later open AARCHMRS commit.
Diff canonical A64, A32, and T32 leaves, aliases, feature conditions, encoding masks, and operations against the 2026-03 baseline.
Add reviewed cdisasm corpus probes for every newly allocated or changed encoding before changing a coverage state.
Do not infer 2026-06 opcode allocation from processor age, marketing names, or a mnemonic-only manual search.

arm_2026_06_manual_delta.reason: The pinned openly licensed AARCHMRS repository ends at 2026-03. The official 2026-06 A64 and AArch32 XML release deltas were reviewed locally under their proprietary notice but are not copied or used to generate checked-in tables. A64 adds FEAT_HINTE; AArch32 adds no instruction XML file. HINTE was implemented from independently verifiable public encoding facts and checked against upstream LLVM.

arm: Exact fixed-layout operands and authoritative named-profile admission for generated A32 and T32 leaves
Remaining fixed-width FP and Advanced SIMD operand arrangements and legality boundaries
SVE/SVE2 operands, MOVPRFX context, vector-length constraints, and allocated/reserved boundary evidence
SME/SME2 streaming, ZA, ZT0, matrix-state semantics, and named-profile policy
LSE2/LSE128/RCpc operands and version gates plus independently reviewed post-2026-03 architectural additions
x86: Late register-relation and complete legacy-prefix legality for the pinned generated descriptor inventory
Independent operand and malformed-neighbor oracles across generated VEX, EVEX, AVX-512, gather/scatter, and conversion forms
Suppressed execution state and state-sized memory or tile operands in AVX10, APX, and AMX forms
CPU, vendor, privilege, and runtime-family policy for remaining generated security, virtualization, UINTR, TDX, and SNP forms
Primary-source inventory and collision review for undocumented or newer-than-pinned XED encodings

method.arm_mask_limit: fixed-mask matching does not evaluate decode assertion or feature-expression ASTs
method.catalog_evidence_ledger: one deterministic generated witness per catalog-only IFORM; exact XED identity/length and passing decoder corpus are recorded separately from operand, formatter and CPU-legality contracts
method.catalog_limit: a public name ID is vocabulary only and does not prove decoder reachability
method.exact_arm_evidence: checked-in complete byte row converted with its endian transport option and uniquely matching the most-specific inherited AARCHMRS fixed mask
method.exact_x86_evidence: checked-in complete byte row decoded by pinned xed-dec to one XED IFORM
method.generated_x86_assignment: the exact IFORM occurs in the numeric fallback descriptor inventory; this proves table assignment, not every late validity assertion or semantic effect
method.source_assignment_limit: a source mnemonic reference is weak evidence and does not prove every upstream form

x86.semantic_limit: compact-XED register relations, suppressed state, dynamic sizes, exhaustive prefix legality/actions and alias presentation remain independent review boundaries
